positiveControls.productionCli: All scenarios build and exercise the real production CLI; SC-1 records through bounded docker exec in the isolated PG19 namespace and reports through the host binary.
positiveControls.fixtures: All synthetic archives are reopened and validated. SC-1 proves fresh PG19 identity, stable active stats_reset, NULL untouched stats_reset, three ticks and readable reports before classification.
positiveControls.isolation: SC-1 requires HostConfig.NetworkMode=none, publishes no host port, writes the archive as the host uid/gid, and aligns recorder filenames, host bounds and report parsing in explicit UTC.
positiveControls.replay: SC-2 proves mixed-version readability and known deltas; SC-10 validates all layout fixtures and same-layout controls before boundary assertions.
positiveControls.providers: Not applicable: no external providers, DTOs, or recorded provider baselines.
positiveControls.sanitization: Final logs pass sanitize.py; raw archives/transcripts/build logs are trap-deleted from restrictive external temporary directories.

featureValidation.scenarios: SC-1, SC-2, SC-3, SC-4 and SC-10 all 0/pass/complete
